headline: Congress named a Post Office building in Anaheim, California, after Dr. William I. 'Bill' Kott.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 333 West Broadway in Anaheim, California, as the Dr. William I. 'Bill' Kott Post Office Building. It changes only the name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the name change took effect on that date.
